title: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.07226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers reduce parameter count by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but parameter sharing alone does not determine how the results of repeated computation are reused. We take the depth-memory view of residual connections and analyze which representation is stored after each block application and how later reads weight it. A full block output contains both its input and its new update, so weighting that output also reweights the history already carried by the input. Reading individual updates instead, with the shared stack's input kept on a separate path, gives separate controls over input strength, total update weight, and allocation across updates. The Loopback Transformer implements these controls: geometric decay sets the total update weight and supplies a recency prior, and attention learns how to allocate that weight. translated_title: Loopback Transformer：迈向残差循环Transformer的统一视角
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享模块来减少参数量，但仅靠参数共享并不能决定重复计算的结果如何被复用。我们从残差连接的“深度即记忆”视角出发，分析每次模块应用后存储的是何种表示，以及后续读取如何对其进行加权。一个完整的模块输出既包含其输入，也包含新的更新，因此对该输出加权也会同时对输入中已携带的历史信息重新加权。相反，若改为读取各次单独的更新，并将共享堆栈的输入保留在单独的路径上，就可以对输入强度、总更新权重以及各次更新之间的分配实现分别控制。Loopback Transformer实现了这些控制：几何衰减设定总更新权重并提供近因先验，注意力机制则学习如何分配这一权重。在ClimbMix数据集上，Loopback以标准Transformer基线40-75%的参数量取得了更低的验证损失。
tldr: 本文提出Loopback Transformer，将共享模块的输入与各次更新分离读取，用几何衰减设定总更新权重、用注意力学习权重分配，实现了对残差循环计算中信息复用的统一精细控制，从而以更少参数取得更低验证损失。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Loopback Transformer, which unifies residual looped computation by reading individual block updates separately—using geometric decay to set the total update weight and attention to learn its allocation—achieving lower validation loss than standard Transformers with only 40-75% of the parameters.
